cmd:
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN= /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
D=/opt/trading-bot/classic
for f in classic_strategy classic_pos_html classic_panel classic_test_sweep; do curl -sfH "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/$f.py" -o $D/$f.py; done
chown -R tbot:tbot $D
for f in classic_strategy classic_pos_html classic_panel; do /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python -m py_compile $D/$f.py && echo COMPILED $f; done
cd $D && timeout 80 sudo -u tbot /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python classic_test_sweep.py 2>&1 | tail -5
echo ---; tail -n 6 $D/out_exit.txt
